item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-416626fb29048098","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Deqin County funded five elder-care meal facilities with 1.4285 million yuan, began construction of six community elder-care service centers with total investment of 21.6 million yuan, and completed or initiated 300 household age-adaptation renovations for elderly people with disabilities, functional limitations, or high support needs.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 local implementation; attribution to Xi Jinping is indirect through national and provincial policy alignment.","ruler_attribution":"The report says the county acted under county Communist Party and government leadership and provincial/state civil-affairs guidance; it does not identify a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["Local-government report; no independent evaluation of service quality or distributional adequacy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-416626fb29048098","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Deqin County expanded minimum-living-guarantee standards and disbursed 42.4561 million yuan in urban and rural subsistence assistance, while also providing targeted support to poor, disabled, elderly, child, disaster-affected, and medically vulnerable residents.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 executed social-assistance measures and reported outputs.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes implementation to the county civil-affairs bureau under county Party and government leadership, with broader national policy context.","limitations":["Administrative figures are self-reported; no independent evidence of exclusion errors, take-up, or longer-term outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-416626fb29048098","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Deqin County reported 26,856 disability-subsidy payments totaling 2.4458 million yuan, including care and hardship subsidies, and reported 360 child-welfare subsidy payments totaling 469,100 yuan.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 payments and beneficiaries.","ruler_attribution":"The report presents these as county civil-affairs implementation of disability and child-welfare programs; personal attribution to Xi is not established.","limitations":["Payment counts are not unique beneficiaries; no independent audit or assessment of adequacy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-416626fb29048098","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Deqin County reported monthly monitoring of social-assistance eligibility, cross-department information sharing, verification of deaths and household finances, and adjustment of assistance lists when circumstances changed.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","6B.7","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported as a 2023 administrative practice.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the practice to county civil-affairs administration pursuant to a prefectural information-sharing notice; no personal Xi directive is cited.","limitations":["The report does not provide error rates, appeal outcomes, or independent verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-416626fb29048098","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Deqin County reported that no new cases of early marriage and early childbearing occurred in 2023, and that all 48 villages and communities had established red-and-white councils, with 183 ceremonies handled under local customs rules.","question_ids":["6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 local administrative reporting.","ruler_attribution":"County implementation is linked to national and provincial policy themes but not to a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["No independent confirmation or evidence that reported absence of new cases reflects complete detection."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfa0a567f8d47f70","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"At the March 2023 Boao Forum for Asia session on global geopolitical outlook, China’s assistant foreign minister Nong Rong said China’s Global Security Initiative was consistent with efforts to safeguard and promote world peace and security; the ICRC used the session to call on all states to make respect for international humanitarian law a political priority.","question_ids":["1B.2","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","8B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers a March 2023 diplomatic forum and official Chinese statement.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was delivered by a Chinese assistant foreign minister and concerned the Xi-era Global Security Initiative; it does not document Xi’s personal decision or implementation.","limitations":["The source records rhetoric and forum participation, not resulting policy or compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-65c5b67a9ad6ca7a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The CECC’s 2023 annual report documented alleged systematic human-rights violations by PRC authorities, including arbitrary detention and torture of political prisoners, digital and biometric surveillance, transnational repression, forced labor, Xinjiang abuses, suppression of civil society and religion, and harsh enforcement of zero-COVID measures.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report concerns human-rights and rule-of-law conditions during 2023, although released in May 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The commission explicitly frames the findings as accountability for Xi Jinping and the CCP, but the supplied excerpt is a commission summary rather than the underlying case evidence.","limitations":["External commission assessment; the excerpt summarizes a larger report and does not provide all underlying case details."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7690679a3b5145f2","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, Reporters Without Borders stated that China ranked 179th of 180 countries in its World Press Freedom Index and that at least 112 journalists and press-freedom defenders were detained; it called for their release and an end to censorship and information control.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly covers the July 2023 assessment and reported detention count.","ruler_attribution":"RSF attributes the broader campaign against journalism to Xi Jinping’s rule since 2012.","limitations":["RSF assessment and reported minimum detention count; the excerpt does not identify each detention or establish personal orders by Xi."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02ad4dc57e15cd87","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 24 February 2023, China issued a twelve-point position paper calling for respect for sovereignty, cessation of hostilities, resumed peace talks, civilian and POW protection, humanitarian access, nuclear-power-plant safety, opposition to nuclear use and proliferation, and post-conflict reconstruction in the Ukraine crisis.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers an official Chinese policy document issued in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Issued by China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs during Xi Jinping’s rule; the excerpt does not document Xi’s personal authorship or implementation.","limitations":["The document states policy positions and recommendations; it does not establish compliance, leverage over combatants, or achieved de-escalation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-68866c22348421eb","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 20 October 2023, China issued a Global AI Governance Initiative calling for human-centered AI, international cooperation, risk testing and tiered governance, privacy and data-security laws, anti-discrimination safeguards, ethical review and accountability, human control, and broader developing-country participation in global AI governance.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers an official Chinese initiative issued in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs during Xi Jinping’s tenure and reflecting the government’s stated program; the excerpt does not establish personal Xi authorship or domestic implementation.","limitations":["The initiative is principally a statement of proposed principles; the source does not show enacted safeguards, funding, enforcement, or independent review."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c896ba57225be509","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"China’s disability-protection law requires governments to include disability programs in development plans and budgets, prohibit disability discrimination, consult disabled people and their organizations on relevant policies, and provide stable fiscal support and administrative coordination.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.3","6B.8","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The supplied text is a standing legal framework in force during 2023, not a 2023 enactment.","ruler_attribution":"The law establishes national and local government duties but does not attribute them to a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The source establishes formal rules, not 2023 enforcement, funding adequacy, access, or remedy outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c896ba57225be509","start_unit":8,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"China’s disability-protection law provides for social insurance, subsistence, medical, rehabilitation, assistive-device, care, education, housing, and other assistance for disabled people, and creates complaint, investigation, administrative-sanction, litigation, and legal-aid mechanisms for rights violations.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.7","6B.8","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The supplied text is a standing legal framework applicable during 2023, not a 2023 enactment.","ruler_attribution":"The framework assigns duties to governments and institutions; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["Formal remedies and benefits are not evidence by themselves of implementation, uptake, or effective enforcement in 2023."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-c1e2f4e99f2d5bca","SRC-6e637f322da15b9c","SRC-f3f9553f14e9896e","SRC-9bdcb6ed3184c241","SRC-53c64ced10426203"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are dated 2024 or later and therefore were not used as 2023-2023 facts unless their supplied text directly reported a 2023 event.","The evidence is heterogeneous and often concerns Chinese national or local institutions rather than personally attributable decisions by Xi Jinping.","No scores were assigned."]}
